in_marathi.name: Jigyasa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jigyasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jigyasa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jignasu’, which means ‘to inquire’ or ‘to seek knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom is Saraswati, and Jigyasa can be seen as an embodiment of her curious and inquisitive nature.
